§bGTNH Addon Quests§r

The mod behind Chapters 1-21. On every world load it adds or updates its chapters in the quest book and keeps your progress, so updating the jar is all you need.

§eStatus log§r: config/gtnhaddonquests/status.log lists what was added or updated and any item it couldn't find.
§eServer§r: install it on the server and every client.

§aTask§r: tick the box once you've read this.
